intro: Five long reads people saved with Xtracticle this week — from an AI motion-design workflow to a first-principles take on parenting.

items.author: Movez
items.title: How to build motion design studio with Opus 5.5 (Full-course)
items.summary: A step-by-step course for getting real motion graphics out of an AI model: have it write a renderer instead of a video, feed it references and a precise spec, and make it review its own frames.

items.author: 龙海
items.title: 万字长文（含配图），讲清楚育儿的第一性原理
items.summary: A long, illustrated essay (in Chinese) that models a child’s growth as a tree — family climate as the roots, the parent–child relationship as the trunk, core skills as the branches — and uses it to explain teenage turbulence.

items.author: 想风
items.title: 万字长文 ｜超详细的 GitHub 教程，从入门到精通
items.summary: A thorough beginner-to-advanced GitHub guide (in Chinese): why Git and GitHub are different things, the four concepts you actually need, reading an open-source project, your first pull request, Actions and Pages.

items.author: Joe
items.title: Its not just the f*cking sandbox
items.summary: A security engineer at an AI lab, writing in a personal capacity, describes what recent AI incidents look like from the inside and argues for a culture of reasonable paranoia over one-line fixes.

items.author: Buzz
items.title: How to Stop Procrastinating and Wasting Time
items.summary: Seven practical habits for getting started when you know what to do but don’t do it — find the discomfort, start small, decide in advance, act before motivation shows up and recover fast.
